Add-Ons 1.6.1: Unknown sectors are assigned to nearby factions (cluster/neighbor), otherwise Xenon.
Add-Ons 1.8.1: This modifier is now given to hard mode to balance with reduced nation milestones.

However, hard mode gets a softer version where unknown sectors without neighbors aren't conquered by the Xenon.
First pass: go through unknown sectors near clustered neighbors and nearby neighbors.
On insane, go through nearby ccommonwealth (3 jumps away). Otherwise, append to isolated unknown sectors and check those later.
Add-Ons 1.11: On hard, move to next unknown sector. On insane, check for any commonwealth factions 3 jumps away. If no nearby commonwealth faction, save the sector for a second check.
The array is returned in descending order. Grab the tail if possible.
=== Execute conquest. If a sector is truly isolated, save it for later. ===
This second check is performed only on insane mode, not on hard difficulty. Check the isolated sectors one last time to see if they're truly isolated.
Check for any commonwealth factions 3 jumps away. Otherwise, conquer for the Xenon.
The array is returned in descending order. Grab the tail if possible.
$t = 'isolated sector: ' + $isolatedSector + '; nearby sectors: ' + $nearbySectors + '; chosen conqueror: ' + $conqueror + ' from ' + $nearestSector

Yaki revolution happens randomly 1-2 days after first player sector
Add-Ons 1.5.6: Update this wording. Boarding is now an alternative way to start the OCV plot.
1. If one or more neighboring races already belong to a cluster, give to a random such race.
2. Otherwise, give to a random neighboring race.
3. If no neighbors, give to Xenon on insane; otherwise keep Unknown.
